House Technology is the YouTube Channel witch show you about building the house by hand especially rescue pet and animal from dangerous place or animal who face at risk by human activity or natural and diseases to care, feed and build them the beautiful house by hand and ancient skills.

My purpose is to show people around the world that the pets and animals should be defended by humans and we have to give them care and love.
Also, I would like to share my talent and creative ideas in pet's house building and pet's yard creating and make good environment for them.
